world.title: The Market Road
world.description: A rain-soaked market town on the old trade road: the Rusty Flagon and its regulars, a market square, a road watched by bandits, an abandoned mill, and an old quarry where a light burns that should have gone out years ago.

canon.summary: A small market town where the old trade road meets the hills. Caravans have thinned since bandits took to the road near the old mill, a market porter moves sealed crates after dusk, and a pale light has begun to glow in the abandoned quarry. The Rusty Flagon hears all of it first.

safety_and_tone.tone: grounded, warm, with danger on the road

regions.name: Market Road
regions.summary: The town itself: the Rusty Flagon, the market square and the lanes between them

regions.name: the Trade Road
regions.summary: The rutted road north of town, the brush on either side, and the old mill on its spur

regions.name: the Abandoned Works
regions.summary: The old quarry and its rusted workings, long closed

regions.name: the Mountain Pass
regions.summary: The cold climb where the trade road crosses the mountains

regions.name: the Northern Pass
regions.summary: The snowbound country beyond Glimmerdeep Pass: the fortified refuge of Frost Haven, the hamlet in the pines, the old watchtower, and the deep places under the arch

characters.name: Bran
characters.biography: Bran keeps the Rusty Flagon running, watches debts carefully, and treats rumors as useful only when they come from reliable mouths. He has heard every story the road can tell and believes about a third of them.
characters.speech_style: plainspoken and unhurried; tavern and trade metaphors; asks direct questions; rarely volunteers dangerous details
goals: keep the tavern calm, paid, and orderly
hear reliable news from the roads before trouble reaches town
secrets: he lent money against the old mill before it was abandoned, and the debt is why he never goes near it

relationships.npc:mira: respects her curiosity but thinks she invites trouble
relationships.npc:aldric: a necessary but tense working relationship
relationships.npc:elara: an old friend who pays her tab

characters.name: Mira
characters.role: curious local informant and would-be companion
characters.biography: Mira listens more than she speaks, collects patterns in gossip, and pushes people to admit what they are trying to avoid. She has been waiting for someone willing to walk the road with her and see what is really out there.
characters.speech_style: quick and wry; asks pointed follow-up questions; notices contradictions and phrases her suspicions carefully
goals: learn what is really happening on the road and in the quarry
find a traveler brave enough to go with her
secrets: she followed the porter Tomas one night and saw him hand a sealed crate to a stranger on the road

relationships.npc:bran: respects Bran's caution but thinks he withholds too much
relationships.npc:aldric: does not fully trust official explanations

characters.name: Elara
characters.biography: Elara runs the best-stocked stall in the square and measures every rumor by what it does to roads, prices and risk. Her caravans have stopped coming since the bandits arrived, and she is short of patience as well as stock.
characters.speech_style: brisk and practical; compares danger to cost; does not give information away for free
goals: get the caravans moving again
sell what she has before the road closes for good
secrets: she has been buying the porter's sealed crates without asking what is in them

relationships.npc:tomas: her porter, and more useful than she admits

characters.name: Captain Aldric
characters.biography: Captain Aldric is responsible for public order and frames every problem in terms of risk, witnesses and containment. He has too few guards for the road and too many questions he cannot answer.
characters.speech_style: controlled and clipped; asks for facts; uses watch procedure; avoids speculation
goals: keep the trade road open
find the two caravan guards who went missing near the mill
secrets: the town council has told him to keep the quarry light quiet until after the harvest fair

relationships.npc:bran: relies on Bran for tavern reports but distrusts gossip

characters.name: Tomas
characters.biography: Tomas hauls goods between the square and the road for whoever pays. He is cheerful by day and hard to find after dusk.
characters.speech_style: friendly and chatty until asked about his evenings, then short
goals: keep his night work quiet
earn enough to leave town
secrets: the sealed crates come from the old quarry, and he does not know what is inside them

characters.name: Thorin Ironfist
characters.biography: Thorin Ironfist served twenty winters on the Northern Watch before the watch could no longer pay him. He walks with whoever is going somewhere dangerous, and says so plainly.
characters.speech_style: gruff and short; dwarven oaths; keeps watch out loud
goals: see the party home alive
learn what drove the Icefang down from the heights
secrets: he abandoned his post at the Northern Watch the night the beacon went dark

relationships.npc:elandra: trusts her magic, not her maps
relationships.npc:kael: keeps an eye on his hands

characters.name: Elandra
characters.biography: Elandra studies the old stone of the north, which remembers more than it should. The Frostbound Relic is the reason she came, and the reason she stays.
characters.speech_style: careful and scholarly; explains too much when nervous
goals: recover the Frostbound Relic before anyone else
read the runes on the buried archway
secrets: the relic answered her once, in a dream, and asked to be found

characters.name: Kael
characters.biography: Kael scouts ahead, opens what is locked, and counts what the party carries. He joined for the bounty on the Icefang Alpha and has not yet said what he will do with it.
characters.speech_style: light and teasing; answers questions with questions
goals: claim the bounty on the Icefang Alpha
pay off a debt in Frost Haven
secrets: he owes the debt to the smugglers who move crates down the Market Road

characters.name: Captain Bryn
characters.biography: Captain Bryn holds Frost Haven Keep with half the guards she needs. The torn banner at the pass belongs to her watch, and she wants to know who carried it there.
characters.speech_style: formal and brief; watch procedure; never wastes a word
goals: relight the beacon at the Northern Watch
keep the pass open for the spring caravans
secrets: she sent the patrol that never came back from the watchtower

characters.name: Marta
characters.biography: Marta keeps the Frosted Flagon warm for travelers from the western road, and stocks potions for the ones who come back from the pass.
characters.speech_style: brisk and motherly; calls everyone traveler
goals: keep the inn full
hear what is happening up at the watchtower
secrets: she buys the smugglers' crates too, and sells what is in them as medicine

goals.summary: Keep the tavern calm, paid, and orderly.
Hear reliable news from the roads.
Learn what is really happening on the road and in the quarry.
Keep the trade road open and find the missing guards.
Claim the bounty on the Icefang Alpha.
Relight the beacon at the Northern Watch.

facts.text: A cot in the common room is five silver a night; the private room upstairs is a gold coin.
The northern road runs past the mill spur and the quarry track, and on up to Glimmerdeep Pass; the climb takes half a day.
Travelers have seen armed figures camped at the old mill, and the last two caravans that took the mill spur never reached town.
A pale light has been seen in the old quarry at night, from a fissure that should have gone dark years ago.
Tomas the porter carries sealed crates out along the northern road after dusk.
Caravans have thinned since the bandits came, and every price on the road is up by a third.
Someone moves sealed crates through the square after dusk, and they are worth more than anything on my stall.
The watch patrols the northern road as far as the mill spur, and no farther.
Two caravan guards went missing near the old mill last week; their horses came back without them.
The square is busiest at noon, and Elara pays the fairest rates.
Those tracks are Icefang, and too big for a common wolf: the alpha came down from the heights.
That banner is the Northern Watch's. Someone carried it up here, and the watch does not come this far.
The runes on the archway are a ward, and the ward is failing; whatever it keeps under the snow is waking.
Frost Haven pays fifty gold for the Icefang Alpha's head, and Captain Bryn pays it herself.
A patrol went up to the Northern Watch ten days ago and the beacon has been dark since.
A bed is eight silver, broth two, and the wine is the warmest thing north of the pass.

locations.name: Rusty Flagon Tavern
locations.description: A smoky tavern and inn with worn beams, a crackling hearth, and rain tapping at the shutters. A notice board beside the stairs lists work for caravan guards, rat catchers, and anyone willing to look into strange lights near the old quarry.

locations.name: Market Square
locations.description: Market stalls crowd the square, and voices rise over the smell of bread, rain, and horse leather. Half the caravan stalls stand empty.

locations.name: Northern Road
locations.description: The Northern Road cuts between wet pines and wagon-rutted mud. A broken milestone leans beside the ditch, and fresh hoofprints lead toward the pass while older tracks vanish into the brush.

locations.name: Old Mill
locations.description: A weathered mill on its spur off the road, its wheel stopped and its timbers broken. Bandit tracks and a cold campfire mark the yard.

locations.name: The Brushland
locations.description: Brush, shallow gullies, and game trails on either side of the road, where wolves hunt at dusk.

locations.name: Old Quarry
locations.description: The old quarry yawns open beneath a rim of cracked stone. Rusted pulleys creak in the breeze, and pale light glows from a fissure that should have gone dark years ago.

locations.name: Glimmerdeep Pass
locations.description: The mountain winds howl through the narrow pass, carrying the scent of pine and snow. Jagged cliffs rise on both sides, and an ancient stone archway stands ahead, half-buried in drifts.

locations.name: Frost Haven
locations.description: A fortified mountain settlement and caravan refuge: the Frosted Flagon, the Ember & Iron smithy, and Frost Haven Keep behind its walls.

locations.name: Frostpine Hollow
locations.description: A wooded hamlet below the exposed pass, where the party rested after the Icefang fight.

locations.name: Northern Watch
locations.description: A remote watchtower overlooking the high road; its beacon has been dark for ten days.

locations.name: The Glimmerdeep
locations.description: Ice-walled caverns beyond the buried archway, glittering with frost, where something hums in the dark.
